services.name: Hilton Head Skiff Guided Boat Tour
services.desc: 25+ mile excursion through salt marsh and local waterways! Rates Adults (ages 13 and up) - $145 Children (ages 5-12) - $125 Duration 2 hours and 15 minutes About Do you want to try something exciting and different on Hilton Head Island this year? Come join us while we explore Hilton Head, Bluffton, Daufuskie, and other surrounding islands on a 25 – 30-mile dolphin watch and drive-it-yourself boat tour. On our Hilton Head dolphin tour, we make stops for dolphins, talk about interesting history, and see great sights along the way. Our guides lead the way in a separate but identical boat while you operate our easy-to-drive, two-person catamaran, which is known for being compact yet quick. Our

includes: We provide ice water and dry storage on each guided boat tour of Hilton Head.
We provide a 6-pack cooler with water and you may bring snacks if you wish.
